entries.title: Maharashtra Shops and Establishments Act 2017
entries.content:
Maharashtra Shops and Establishments Act 2017 (StatutoryAct)
Citation: Maharashtra Act LXI of 2017
Key facts: jurisdiction: Maharashtra, India; year: 2017; mandatory: True
Related rule (CONTAINS_SECTION -> Section 13: Opening, Closing Hours & Daily Limits): Maharashtra Act 2017 establishes standard 9h/day and 48h/week working limits. Basis: Maharashtra Act LXI of 2017
Related rule (CONTAINS_SECTION -> Section 14: Overtime Working & Double Wages): Maharashtra Act 2017 mandates 2x overtime rate and 11h daily spread limit. Basis: Maharashtra Act LXI of 2017
Related rule (CONTAINS_SECTION -> Section 15: Mandatory Interval for Rest): Maharashtra Act 2017 mandates 30-minute rest interval after 5h continuous work. Basis: Maharashtra Act LXI of 2017
Related rule (CONTAINS_SECTION -> Section 18: Statutory Leave with Wages & Casual Leaves): Maharashtra Act 2017 guarantees Earned Leave (1 per 20 days) and 8 days Casual Leave. Basis: Maharashtra Act LXI of 2017

entries.title: Section 14: Overtime Working & Double Wages
entries.content:
Section 14: Overtime Working & Double Wages (StatutorySection)
Citation: Section 14, Maharashtra Act 2017
Key facts: overtime multiplier: 2.0; max daily spread hours: 11; quarterly cap hours: 125
Related rule (from Maharashtra Shops and Establishments Act 2017, CONTAINS_SECTION): Maharashtra Act 2017 mandates 2x overtime rate and 11h daily spread limit. Basis: Maharashtra Act LXI of 2017
Related rule (MANDATES_INVARIANT -> Mandatory Daily 11-Hour Hard Ceiling): Under Section 14(2), no employee is permitted to work beyond 11 hours in any single day. Basis: Section 14(2), Maharashtra Act 2017
Related rule (MANDATES_INVARIANT -> Statutory 2.0x Double Wage Rate for Overtime): Under Section 14(1), any work exceeding 9 hours/day or 48 hours/week is remunerated at 2.0x normal wage rate. Basis: Section 14(1), Maharashtra Act 2017
Related rule (GOVERNS_POLICY -> Enterprise Work Hours & Overtime Policy): Enterprise overtime compensation strictly enforces 2.0x pay and 11-hour daily cap. Basis: Section 14, Maharashtra Act 2017

entries.title: Section 18: Statutory Leave with Wages & Casual Leaves
entries.content:
Section 18: Statutory Leave with Wages & Casual Leaves (StatutorySection)
Citation: Section 18, Maharashtra Act 2017
Key facts: statutory el accrual rate: 1 day per 20 days worked; statutory cl quota: 8; max el carryover: 45
Related rule (from Maharashtra Shops and Establishments Act 2017, CONTAINS_SECTION): Maharashtra Act 2017 guarantees Earned Leave (1 per 20 days) and 8 days Casual Leave. Basis: Maharashtra Act LXI of 2017
Related rule (MANDATES_INVARIANT -> Earned Leave 45-Day Maximum Accumulation Cap): Under Section 18(1)(a), unavailed Earned Leave accumulation cannot exceed 45 days. Basis: Section 18(1)(a), Maharashtra Act 2017
Related rule (MANDATES_INVARIANT -> Mandatory MBBS/MD Medical Certificate for >2 Consecutive Sick Days): Statutory framework supports mandatory medical documentation for illness absences exceeding 2 consecutive days. Basis: Section 18, Maharashtra Act 2017
Related rule (GOVERNS_POLICY -> Enterprise Earned Leave (EL) Policy 2026): Section 18 sets minimum 12 days EL; Enterprise policy provides higher benefit of 18 days per year. Basis: Section 18, Maharashtra Act 2017
Related rule (from Enterprise Earned Leave (EL) Policy 2026, OVERRIDES_WITH_HIGHER_BENEFIT): Company grants 18 days Earned Leave annually (1.5 days/month), exceeding the statutory minimum of 12 days. Basis: Company Leave Policy § 4.1
Related rule (GOVERNS_POLICY -> Enterprise Casual Leave (CL) Policy 2026): Company Casual Leave aligns exactly with statutory 8 days quota and non-carryover rules. Basis: Section 18(1)(b), Maharashtra Act 2017
